text:
julia: Quick triage — nightly eval flagged 5 failing suites for the smol-v2-int4 candidate around 00:04 UTC. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/2345 :eyes:

sam: Which suites? short list pls, I can grab logs.

eval-bot: nightly-eval alert: suites failing = [legal-snippets, longcontext, numeric-rewrite, structured-output, instruction-contradict]. severity=medium. regression magnitude: BLEU -7, ROUGE -5, exact-match down 12%.

anika: eyeballing the longcontext failures — pattern looks like prefix truncation + a bunch of empty tokens at tail. saw repeated KV-cache evictions in the worker logs.

matt: can you paste the log lines?

anika: sure, snippet from worker-13 around 00:03:58:

```
2025-04-09T00:03:58Z WARN kvcache: evict_shard id=13 seq=4096 reason=ttl size_bytes=0
2025-04-09T00:03:58Z DEBUG decoder: kv_lookup miss seq=4097 key=0x7f3a... -> fallback
2025-04-09T00:03:59Z ERROR generation: produced <EOS> prematurely len=2
```

sam: that size_bytes=0 is suspicious — suggests we wrote an empty segment after quantization kernel switch. Haven't seen that in int8 runs.

julia: good call. this candidate was built with the new qkernel path that packs attention keys differently. risk: index math bug when chunk_size != 1024.

matt: I can take ownership to repro locally. steps I'll run: (1) bring up unit test for kv chunk write/read, (2) run nightly eval subset with deterministic seeds, (3) compare int8 vs int4 kv dumps.

sam: assign to @matt + @anika. severity: P2 (medium) unless we see customer impact.

anika: quick hack to validate: rerun the failing longcontext cohort with a small patch that disables the new pack path (fall back to old serialization). if failures disappear -> kernel bug.

matt: starting repro now. will post a minimal reproducer within 20–30m.

julia: thanks. created follow-up ticket RDW-4821 and added triage notes + links to logs. tagging infra on-call to hold capacity for reproduction.

sam: if reproducer looks good, we should revert qkernel change on the candidate build and re-run the full nightly. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: update: nightly-eval rerun (subset) queued by matt at 00:27 UTC.

julia: update in thread — matt, ping when you have the reproducer and we can decide rollback vs patch. :thinking:
